card.name: Chemotherapy regimen numbers and 5-fluorouracil
card.fires_on: The first digit or start of a term in chemotherapy regimen text, such as the 5 in 5-fluorouracil, the digit in '21-day' or '22-hour', and 'single' before agent.

modes.label: 5-fluorouracil start

modes.label: Single agent
